objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

objects.taxonomy_description: Swift leporid mammal measuring 45-70 cm body length with elongated body and powerful hind limbs. Fur dense in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration. Ears exceptionally long (10-15 cm) with black tips. Hind legs massively elongated with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping at speeds exceeding 60 km/h. Forelegs shorter. Tail short. Young born precocial with full fur coat and open eyes. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Timid behavior with cryptic resting posture. Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.

Head_and_Face: Exceptionally long ears with black tips, markedly longer than rabbit ears.
Body_and_Plumage: Elongated body with powerful hind limbs, notably larger than rabbit.
Dense fur in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration.
Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Massively elongated hind legs with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping.

objects.taxonomy_description: An inanimate manufactured object designed for play, distinguished from living organisms by artificial materials and static morphology.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Composition: Surface exhibits synthetic textures such as molded plastic, stitched fabric, or painted finishes rather than biological skin, fur, or scales.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Joints: Presence of visible mechanical articulations, seams, screws, or uniform molding lines indicating assembly rather than natural anatomical growth.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Morphological_Symmetry: Features display exaggerated proportions, perfect geometric symmetry, or stylized simplifications that deviate from realistic biological anatomy.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Contextual_Indicators: Object lacks signs of life such as respiration, movement blur, or environmental interaction typical of living creatures, often appearing static and posed.
